entries.wording: Le transporteur a reçu les informations électroniques de l'envoi.
entries.note: The first row: the shipment's data, before any scan.

entries.wording: L'envoi a été pris en charge par l'entrepôt local au départ.
entries.note: The origin warehouse took the parcel.

entries.wording: Le colis est arrivé au centre de traitement d'origine à ….
entries.note: The row names the origin city.

entries.wording: Le colis a été trié et attend son départ.
Le traitement au départ est terminé. L'envoi est en préparation pour le transport international.
L'envoi est prêt à être transféré vers l'aéroport de départ.
L'envoi est arrivé au terminal de fret de l'aéroport ….
entries.note: The row names the airport of departure.

entries.wording: L'envoi a été remis au transporteur aérien.
L'envoi a quitté l'aéroport … et est en transport international.
entries.note: The row names the airport of departure.

entries.wording: L'envoi est arrivé à l'aéroport ….
entries.note: The row names the destination, by its country code: "in DE".

entries.wording: L'envoi est arrivé au centre de traitement de destination.
Le traitement à destination est terminé.
L'envoi a été remis au transporteur.
entries.note: Handed to the destination courier after the processing there.

entries.wording: L'envoi est arrivé à l'entrepôt local et y est en cours de traitement.
entries.note: The destination courier's warehouse.

entries.wording: L'envoi est dans le réseau de livraison local.
Le colis est arrivé à l'agence locale de livraison desservant la zone du destinataire.
entries.note: At the depot that delivers the recipient's area, before the round.

entries.wording: Order information received by the carrier.
entries.note: The first row: the shipment's data, before any scan.

entries.wording: Consignment received at the local warehouse.
entries.note: The origin warehouse took the parcel. The row names it after "in", with its postcode, which the adapter takes out.

entries.wording: Parcel received at the processing facility ….
entries.note: The row names the origin city.

entries.wording: Parcel sorted and ready for international dispatch ….
entries.note: The row names the origin city.

entries.wording: Parcel departed the processing facility ….
entries.note: The row names the origin city.

entries.wording: Origin processing completed […].
entries.note: The row names the origin city in brackets.

entries.wording: Shipment is ready for transfer to the departure airport.
Shipment arrived at the departure airport cargo facility.
Shipment handed over to the air carrier at the departure airport.
Shipment departed the origin airport; international line-haul transit is in progress.
Shipment arrived at … airport
entries.note: The row names the destination by its country code: "DE Airport".

entries.wording: Shipment arrived at the … destination processing facility.
entries.note: The row names the destination by its country code.

entries.wording: Shipment information has been received for destination processing.
entries.note: The destination's data for the parcel, after its arrival there; the row ends with a doubled full stop.

entries.wording: Arrival processing is in progress.
Destination processing completed.
Shipment transferred to the carrier.
entries.note: Handed to the destination courier after the processing there.

entries.wording: Shipment arrived at the local warehouse; inbound processing is in progress.
entries.note: The destination courier's warehouse.

entries.wording: Shipment entered the local delivery network.
Parcel arrived at the local delivery station.
entries.note: At the depot that delivers the recipient's area, before the round. The row names it after ", serving", with its postcode, which the adapter takes out.

entries.wording: Delivery has been scheduled with the carrier.
entries.note: The delivering courier's round booked, before it starts.

entries.wording: Out for delivery
entries.note: The row names the town after "in", with its postcode and country, which the adapter takes out.

entries.wording: Delivered
entries.note: The row names the town, country and postcode before it, and the recipient's street and house number after it, which the adapter leaves out.
